subject: System Design
title: Load Balancing Algorithms
description: Learn Load Balancing Algorithms in one minute.

hook.text: Ten servers handle traffic. Round-robin sends requests evenly. But server 3 is twice as powerful as server 7.

buildup.text: Load balancers distribute traffic across servers using algorithms: round-robin, least connections, or weighted.

discovery.text: Least connections sends new requests to the server handling the fewest active connections.

twist.text: Health checks ensure sick servers don't receive traffic. Without them, users hit dead servers.

climax.text: The right algorithm depends on whether requests are uniform or some are heavier than others.

punchline.text: Route traffic to healthy servers using the right algorithm.

quiz.question: What does the least-connections algorithm do?
options: Sends new requests to the server with the fewest active connections
Sends all requests to the fastest server
